models.label: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B
models.description: A close match to the recording's voice that copies its delivery; no emotion control. Downloads 4.5 GB of weights; peaked at 4.4 GB of video memory in testing.

models.label: Breeze TTS 2
models.description: A close match whose delivery you can direct: a profile's instruction option steers tone and pace in plain words, and [laughs], [sighs], [coughs] and [clears throat] are performed. Downloads 7.7 GB of weights.

models.label: VoxCPM2
models.description: A close match to the recording's voice that copies its delivery; no emotion control. Downloads 5 GB of weights; peaked at 6.1 GB of video memory in testing.

models.label: Fish Audio S2 Pro
models.description: The most expressive: any short direction in square brackets, such as [whisper], [excited] or [pause], is performed. The slowest of the five. Downloads 11 GB of weights and needs a GPU with at least 12 GB of video memory.

models.label: Chatterbox
models.description: The weakest match of the five but the fastest, the only one that kept ahead of real time in testing. A profile's exaggeration option (0.25 to 2, default 0.5) makes delivery calmer or livelier. Its audio carries Resemble AI's inaudible Perth watermark. Downloads 3.2 GB of weights.
